_note: Edit this file to change what appears under Legal updates. 'group' chooses the list on the page: "ap" (Andhra Pradesh), "consumer" (Consumer law), or leave it out for the general list. 'enabled': false switches a source off. 'keywords': a plain word matches a whole word; a word ending in * matches any word that starts that way (pension* matches pension and pensioners). Leave 'keywords' empty to accept everything from a source. 'exclude' removes matches. 'max_items' is the most items kept per list. A source can have its own 'max_age_days' and 'per_source_limit', and 'date_field': "updated" or "published".
